method.workload: 49 objects, frozen nine-stone state, 120 iterations, CEM keep 32; same YAML and trusted state as excavator-cuda-throughput-tuning.json
method.timing: Fresh processes run sequentially; search.search wall only, no warmup search, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; setup excluded.
method.baseline: Pre-optimization floor/scored files match apps commit 481ac47; retain the current four-worker CUDA results implementation in both versions.
method.baseline_execution: First baseline ran before source edits. Later baselines loaded saved floor module definitions and sampler __init__/score_map into the same process; no worktree checkout or other source rollback.
method.baseline_hook:

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "tests"))
before = sys.argv.pop(1) == "before"
profile = sys.argv.pop(1) == "profile"

    from stacking_common.actions import _scored_floor as floor, scored
    exec(compile(Path("/tmp/mcts-floor-20261003/floor_before.py").read_text(), str(Path(floor.__file__)), "exec"), floor.__dict__)
    namespace = {"__package__": "stacking_common.actions", "__name__": "stacking_common.actions.scored"}
    exec(compile(Path("/tmp/mcts-floor-20261003/scored_before.py").read_text(), str(Path(scored.__file__)), "exec"), namespace)
    previous = namespace["ScoredPlanarPoseSampler"]
    scored.ScoredPlanarPoseSampler.__init__ = previous.__init__
    scored.ScoredPlanarPoseSampler.score_map = previous.score_map
if profile:
    import profile_excavator_cuda_mcts as benchmark
else:
    import benchmark_excavator_cuda_mcts as benchmark
benchmark.main()
method.source_hashes: effective_source_version corrects the two baseline scoring hashes for the process-local reference code; other hashes are as recorded by the benchmark.
method.optimized: Vectorized height-dependent target bounds and boundary scores, batched score normalization, one dilation per map, cached state-map bundle across stones.
limitations: Two CUDA seeds at evaluation 128 / GPU capacity 256; one production batch-32 CUDA seed and one CPU seed.
CPU and CUDA traverse different trees; before/after parity is asserted within each backend, not between backends.
GPU capacity 256 is benchmark-only; no MCTS or solver configuration changes in this optimization.
Timer-only profiles are separate from unprofiled throughput measurements. Inclusive timings overlap.

before.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.

after.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.

floor_preparation_comparison.accounting: Before state-map preparation is nested in score_xy_debug_map; after it is in the sampler. Compare the union of those two stages, without double-counting nested time.
